sample_unit: consent forms (pilot forms benchmarked against a 58-member human baseline)
unlisted_practices: Using LLM-based scoring (UHCI) to audit the quality of informed consent forms across accessibility, transparency, autonomy, system burden and medical adequacy
Benchmarking an LLM evaluator against a multidisciplinary human panel baseline

screen.reason: The study develops and demonstrates the feasibility of an LLM-based tool (UHCI) to evaluate informed consent forms against a human multidisciplinary baseline and across jurisdictions.
